links.outcome: Readability of chatbot GDM patient education text versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: All models produced text above the recommended sixth-grade reading level; ChatGPT-5 best (FKGL 7.43 ± 2.42, FRES 62.47 ± 13.51) but still did not meet guideline targets.
links.quote: All models produced text above the recommended sixth-grade reading level; ChatGPT-5 showed the most favorable readability profile (for example, FKGL 7.43 ± 2.42, FRES 62.47 ± 13.51) but still did not meet guideline targets.
